categories.title: Game Development
categories.description: Updates pertaining to the game mechanics or storyline.

entries.text:
- Created rough draft of 3D model art for three unreleased souls.
- Created rough draft 3D models for three unreleased souls.
- Created rough draft for Soul art for two unreleased souls.

Finished up final miniature models for all current playtest Souls.
Designed rough models for 3 unreleased Souls.
Designed mechanics and playstyle for 1 unreleased Soul.

categories.title: WebApp Development
categories.description: Updates pertaining to the WebApp interface and metadata.

entries.text: Created The Veiled Invitation web app and built the initial interface.
bullets: Added the ability to disable unavailable choices.
Developed two events for The Vivisection Theatre: "The Prize is Deep" and "The Missing Patient".
Developed the opening of The Doll Gallery.

entries.text: Added four events for The Doll Gallery:
Expanded the WebApp’s events and locations.
bullets: Added narration to The Doll Gallery events.
Added one more event for The Vivisection Theatre: "The Cause of Death".
Built The Life-Tithe Emporium’s introduction and pages.

entries.text: Developed the WebApp to be completely mobile, broadcasting from a mobile hot spot on a Raspberry Pi 3.

categories.title: Playtest Simulator Development
categories.description: Updates for the hardware and software development of the mechanics simulator, as well as the results of ran tests.

entries.text: Finished acquisition of simulation hardware. (40 CPU threads, 86GB RAM). Waiting on unmanaged ethernet port arrival.
Repurposed a Z220 workstation as the simulation controller. Fresh installation of Linux done and awaiting connection of simulation hardware and software integration.

categories.title: Website Development
categories.description: This is for changes and updates to The Veiled Invitation website.

entries.text:
Developed website dashboard which allows:
- Visibility on unique visitor count
- Modifying "Studio Live Status" report on both the game and studio site.
- Ability to push development updates to the game site update section.
Added "Updates" page to keep player's up-to-date with the latest changes.
